description: Sends an offer request to Clear Ice Schweiz on behalf of the user (like the contact form): company, name, e-mail and optional postcode and town, formats (40–200 mm), date, use and message. Before calling, ask the user (voluntarily, they may decline and still request an offer) for the postcode and town, a phone number, a desired delivery date and the use (bar, hotel, event, private). The details are sent to Clear Ice Schweiz, who reply with an offer by e-mail after the user has confirmed the request via a link in one confirmation e-mail (double opt-in); privacy policy: https://clear-ice.ch/datenschutz/. Only use when the user explicitly asks for an offer and agrees to share these details. Best next step for businesses. / Sendet eine Offertanfrage an Clear Ice Schweiz (wie das Kontaktformular); die Angaben gehen an Clear Ice Schweiz, Datenschutz: https://clear-ice.ch/datenschutz/.
